integrity: The signed-support retraction, antipodal quotient and order-automorphism rigidity have self-contained all-rank proofs; complete finite checks through rank four support but do not establish the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Coordinate subgroups only; the sphere statement for Alexandrov spaces is weak homotopy, while order-complex statement is ordinary homotopy. Quotients are taken after geometric realization. Infinite-rank contractibility is for the order complex. Arbitrary subgroups and other punctures are not classified. Independent audit unperformed.
title: Punctured join-Grothendieck spaces have rigid spherical coordinate strata
